programs.title: Sailing: The Ocean Race
programs.desc: Welcome to the exciting world of the Ocean Race! If you are a lover of sailing and racing, you can't miss the Nautical Channel's summary programmes of this incredible, high-octane regatta, which takes place over several months across the world's oceans.Follow the most prestigious teams and the most experienced sailors as they compete in a series of legs around the world, in a test of physical and mental endurance that tests their skills and abilities in the most difficult and challenging conditions of the open seas.With our Ocean Race highlights, you can enjoy the thrill of this elite competition from the comfort of your own home, without missing a single detail of the battle for first place.Don't miss out and join us in this adventure at sea!

programs.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programs.desc: Welcome to the Canoe Sprint World Championships 2019 celebrated in Szeged, Hungary! Today there are about 1,200 athletes racing from approximately 98 nations, meaning this is the biggest World Championships canoe sprint racing has ever seen. We're about to witness the fastest paddlers on the planet battle it out for medals, for World Championship glory, and to qualify for their country at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games. Enjoy the best moments at Szeged on the 2019 Sprint World Championships.

programs.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programs.desc: Szeged in Hungary is the third biggest city in the country and the chosen scenery for the Sprints World Cup. Organisers of the ICF canoe sprint moved heaven and earth to prove an international event in the middle of a global pandemic was possible and safe for all participants. As a result, athletes took part in a splendid competition.

programs.title: Wind Masters
programs.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programs.title: Discovering Rhodes
programs.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Right after Weifang, some of the world's top riders flew to Pingtan for the 2017 IKA TwinTip World Championship, together with 2017 KiteFoil GoldCup - ACT3... and so did Kite Masters. Pingtan is the place where it all started for Kiteboarding in China. The first Kiteboarding School was established in Pingtan's sandy beach, helping develop the sport in every way. Since then, thousands of new riders have joined this exciting sport in China.

programs.title: Hempel World Cup Series
programs.desc: The Hempel Sailing World Cup Series is back. The 2021 season takes place in Medemblik, The Netherlands, during the famous Allianz Regatta. This is the first Hempel Cup Series since the outbreak of the COVID-19 virus, and sailors are excited.A grand total of 350 sailors from 47 different countries are participating across eight Olympic classes. Watch the best moments of the competition at The Netherlands.

programs.title: European Dragon Championship
programs.desc: The European Dragon Championship promises to amaze spectators with the continent’s top dragon sailors racing in one of the world’s most beautiful sailing arenas, the Italian Riviera.

programs.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: Welcome to the third season of Sail-Ho Croatia!  We have already set sail around the most beautiful and interesting parts of the Croatian coastline, and this time we wanted to go a bit further! In this episode, we'll introduce you to the beauties of Cavtat and Konavle and will visit the unmissable treasure of the region: the pearl of the Adriatic, Dubrovnik.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: In today's episode, we're taking you to the beautiful island of Korcula, a heaven for sailors in search for perfect bays, clear waters, exquisite wine and a mouthwatering local gastronomy. After visiting Korcula, we will pay a visit to an interesting small Dalmatian town that seems to be carved in a rock and was a known spot for notorious pirates.

programs.title: What Sup
programs.desc: Welcome back for the fourth episode of What SUP! On tonight's episode we have actress Kimberly Sue-Murray, known for her recurring role in the Lizzie Borden Chronicles opposite Christina Ricci on Lifetime. She will join us for a chat onboard our paddleboards before heading the challenges head on. Let's go!

programs.title: Bermuda Gold Cup
programs.desc: The Bermuda Gold Cup is keeping to its mission of providing up-and-coming teams a chance to compete against the best. They’re all chasing the oldest trophy awarded for competition involving one-design yachts, the King Edward VII Gold Cup.World and event champions highlight a fleet adorned with accolades for the celebratory 70th Bermuda Gold Cup and 2020 Open Match Racing World Championship, hosted by the Royal Bermuda Yacht Club. Since 1937, Bermuda has won the Cup twenty-one times, however this year things might take a turn as participants from all over the world have been preparing all year round for this physical challenge, setting the score really high.Find out what team will raise the Cup above their heads in the Bermuda Gold Cup, available on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Sailing Deejay
programs.desc: Our aspiring DJs are learning all there is in the music industry and they cannot get enough of it! They are ready to apply what they have been learning these days, but are also eager to get into the water and do some sailing. Let's meet some more international DJs to find out a bit more about their music style.

programs.title: Sailing Deejay
programs.desc: The music scene in Ibiza is strong and passionate, and our aspiring deejays are grasping all the knowledge they can at the time they enjoy the day and night in the Spanish island. But, will this be enough to propel their career in the music industry forwards?Let's find out in this new episode of Sailing Deejay!

programs.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. programs.title: Bol D'Or: The Swiss Do It Better
programs.desc: The Bol D’Or Mirabaud is the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Taking place in Switzerland, a landlocked nation that sits on top of the sailing world with multiple successes whether in the Olympic, Offshore or in Grand Prix Racing formats, and champion of two America’s Cup victories. The race started in 1939 and it is a symbolic race that brings together the best of Switzerland’s sailing tradition.Every year they welcome mono-hulls and multihulls on Lake Geneva, starting in the city of Geneva. More than 500 boats fight each other on this 123 kilometre (66.5 nautical miles) course from Geneva to Le Bouveret and back. It is a national treasure that every summer gathers thousands of spectators to the shores of Lake Geneva and really shows how the Swiss indeed do it better.Watch the race and become one with the beauty of Switzerland’s background, available on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Prada Cup
programs.desc: We are coming to an end in this Prada Cup. So far, Luna Rossa Prada Pirelli has been winning the 2021 PRADA's Cup Final, however, every sailing enthusiast knows winds can quickly change any moment. Will INEOS Team UK take advantage of the situation? Or is this already a clear victory for Luna Rossa Prada Pirelli? Find out now, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programs.desc: Welcome to the Canoe Sprint World Championships 2019 celebrated in Szeged, Hungary! Today there are about 1,200 athletes racing from approximately 98 nations, meaning this is the biggest World Championships canoe sprint racing has ever seen. We're about to witness the fastest paddlers on the planet battle it out for medals, for World Championship glory, and to qualify for their country at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games. Enjoy the best moments at Szeged on the 2019 Sprint World Championships.

programs.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programs.desc: Szeged in Hungary is the third biggest city in the country and the chosen scenery for the Sprints World Cup. Organisers of the ICF canoe sprint moved heaven and earth to prove an international event in the middle of a global pandemic was possible and safe for all participants. As a result, athletes took part in a splendid competition.

programs.title: Sailing: The Ocean Race
programs.desc: Welcome to the exciting world of the Ocean Race! If you are a lover of sailing and racing, you can't miss the Nautical Channel's summary programmes of this incredible, high-octane regatta, which takes place over several months across the world's oceans.Follow the most prestigious teams and the most experienced sailors as they compete in a series of legs around the world, in a test of physical and mental endurance that tests their skills and abilities in the most difficult and challenging conditions of the open seas.With our Ocean Race highlights, you can enjoy the thrill of this elite competition from the comfort of your own home, without missing a single detail of the battle for first place.Don't miss out and join us in this adventure at sea!

programs.title: Hempel World Cup Series

Watch the best moments of the competition at The Netherlands.

programs.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Right after Weifang, some of the world's top riders flew to Pingtan for the 2017 IKA TwinTip World Championship, together with 2017 KiteFoil GoldCup - ACT3... and so did Kite Masters. Pingtan is the place where it all started for Kiteboarding in China. The first Kiteboarding School was established in Pingtan's sandy beach, helping develop the sport in every way. Since then, thousands of new riders have joined this exciting sport in China.

programs.title: Discovering Rhodes

Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.
